description: Unreal by Future Crew, the winner of the PC demo competition at Assembly '92, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Unreal is Future Crew's demo for MS-DOS, released in August 1992 after it won the PC demo competition at Assembly '92.
This is the 1992 release, for the Sound Blaster and Sound Blaster Pro. Version 1.1, for the Gravis UltraSound, followed in December 1993.
released: Assembly '92: first in the PC demo competition. Released on 6 August 1992.
terms: Its readme gives only the copyright. Future Crew's information files make all their demos freeware: “you can copy and distribute them freely as long as you make no modifications to them.”
accuracy: Its setup starts on No sound: DosKit picks SoundBlaster Pro at 20 kHz.
Its first nine minutes follow a capture made on a real 386DX-40; its last section ends about 50 seconds sooner.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
